description: This file contains unit tests for a configuration redaction and restoration module, verifying that sensitive data such as API keys and private keys are properly redacted and can be restored.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for the configuration snapshot redaction functionality.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Creates an expectation for a test assertion.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases within the test suite.

methods.name: redactConfigSnapshot
methods.description: Redacts sensitive fields within a configuration snapshot using provided hints.

methods.name: makeSnapshot
methods.description: Generates a configuration snapshot object from provided configuration data.

methods.name: restoreRedactedValues
methods.description: Restores redacted values in a configuration object back to their original form.

methods.name: buildConfigSchema
methods.description: Builds and returns the schema object used to generate UI hints and validation rules.

ctags.name: channels
ctags.pattern: /^    const channels = result.config.channels as Record<string, Record<string, unknown>>;$/

ctags.name: config
ctags.pattern: /^    const config = result.config as typeof snapshot.config;$/
